TRADEMARK ASSIGNMENT

THIS TRADEMARK ASSIGNMENT (this "Assignment") is made and entered into as of May 26, 2026, by MARISOL CONFECTIONS LLC, a Louisiana limited liability company with a place of business at 812 Magazine Street, New Orleans, Louisiana 70130 ("Assignor"), in favor of PRALINE HOLDINGS GROUP, INC., a Delaware corporation with a place of business at 200 Poydras Street, Suite 1900, New Orleans, Louisiana 70112 ("Assignee").

RECITALS

A. Assignor owns the trademarks, service marks, and trade dress identified on Schedule A, together with the registrations and applications listed there (collectively, the "Assigned Marks").

B. Assignor also owns the business, and the portion of the business, to which the Assigned Marks pertain, including the recipes, customer lists, supplier relationships, and packaging designs used in connection with the Assigned Marks (the "Associated Business").

C. Assignee wishes to acquire the Assigned Marks together with the goodwill of the business symbolized by them.

NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, Assignor agrees as follows.

1. Assignment.

Assignor hereby irrevocably sells, assigns, transfers, and conveys to Assignee all of Assignor's right, title, and interest in and to: (a) the Assigned Marks; (b) all registrations and applications for the Assigned Marks in the United States and in every foreign country, and all rights to file applications for them; (c) all common-law rights in the Assigned Marks; (d) the goodwill of the business symbolized by the Assigned Marks and the Associated Business; (e) all rights to sue for and collect damages, profits, and other remedies for past, present, and future infringement, dilution, and unfair competition; and (f) all proceeds of the foregoing.

2. Assignment of Goodwill.

The Assigned Marks are assigned together with the goodwill of the business symbolized by them, and this Assignment is not an assignment in gross. Assignee acquires the Associated Business, and no part of this Assignment is effective to transfer a mark apart from the goodwill it symbolizes.

3. Intent-to-Use Applications.

With respect to any application on Schedule A filed under Section 1(b) of the Lanham Act, 15 U.S.C. § 1051(b), for which neither an amendment to allege use nor a statement of use has been filed and accepted, this Assignment is effective only if Assignee is a successor to the Associated Business, or to that portion of it to which the mark pertains, and that business is ongoing and existing, as required by 15 U.S.C. § 1060(a). Assignor represents that Assignee is such a successor.

4. Recordation.

Assignor authorizes and requests the Commissioner for Trademarks to record this Assignment against the Assigned Marks in the records of the United States Patent and Trademark Office under 15 U.S.C. § 1060(a) and 37 C.F.R. § 3.11, and to direct all future correspondence concerning the Assigned Marks to Assignee.

5. Further Assurances.

Assignor shall, without further consideration but at Assignee's expense, execute and deliver all further documents and take all further actions that Assignee reasonably requests to perfect, record, prosecute, maintain, defend, or enforce the Assigned Marks, including declarations under Sections 8 and 15 of the Lanham Act, renewal applications, and assignments in the form any foreign trademark office requires. Assignor irrevocably appoints Assignee as its attorney-in-fact for that purpose if Assignor fails to act within twenty (20) days after written request; this power is coupled with an interest and is irrevocable.

6. Representations and Warranties.

Assignor represents and warrants that: (a) it is the sole owner of the Assigned Marks, free of all liens, licenses, and encumbrances; (b) the registrations on Schedule A are valid and subsisting and all maintenance filings are current; (c) it has not granted any license, covenant not to sue, or consent to use to any person; (d) it has received no notice, and is aware of no claim, that any Assigned Mark infringes or dilutes the rights of any person, and no proceeding is pending or threatened before the Trademark Trial and Appeal Board or any court; and (e) it has the full right and authority to make this Assignment.

7. No Retained Rights.

Assignor retains no right to use the Assigned Marks or any mark confusingly similar to them, and shall cease all use within thirty (30) days after the date of this Assignment, except that Assignor may sell through existing inventory bearing the Assigned Marks for ninety (90) days under Assignee's quality-control standards.

8. Quality Control.

For the transition period described in Section 7, Assignor shall maintain the quality standards Assignee specifies in writing, and Assignee may inspect Assignor's premises and samples on reasonable notice, so that the goodwill assigned is preserved and the Assigned Marks are not abandoned.

9. Governing Law and Forum.

This Assignment is governed by the laws of the State of Louisiana, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles, except that questions of trademark validity, registrability, and infringement are governed by the Lanham Act. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Orleans Parish, Louisiana.

10. Binding Effect; Counterparts.

This Assignment binds Assignor and its successors and assigns and inures to the benefit of Assignee and its successors and assigns. It may be executed in counterparts, and a signature delivered electronically has the same effect as an original.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, Assignor has executed this Trademark Assignment as of the date first written above.
